headline.size_rel: large, 2-4 words per screen, center or left aligned

caption.family_guess: sans (Inter/Neue Montreal-ish) for UI chrome + prompt boxes
caption.size_rel: small, ~UI-scale, sits inside prompt-bar chips not burned full-width captions

layout.safe_zones: top ~8% and bottom ~8% kept clear on phone-mock frames; prompt bar always docked near bottom third
layout.caption_pos: no traditional burned captions; text lives inside on-screen prompt-input chips and short kinetic-type title cards

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: ~6-8 cuts (fast, near 1 new visual per second in dense sections, slower holds ~2s on kinetic-text beats)
